reviews.x: I really like this case. I live in a very small studio with no bathroom counter space and have no room for a vanity. I was beginning to have so many little cosmetic bags I couldn't keep track of which one held what. With this case everything fits. It holds my manicure tools, polish and remover, my hair brushes, all my makeup and lipsticks, all my lotions and creams, my face water, all of it. I also like that the mirror has a stand. And I appreciate the latches that keep the case open on the side
Does not lock! The locks are fake! Keys what a joke!!!!! But other than that the case is awesome!!

I love my case, but I will say the more I closed it, the hinkier the clasps got. I wish the side storage was deeper, because I could only put a few flat things in there or the case wouldn't close. Also the brush holders at the front can only be used with shorter brushes. If they are too long, the case won't close and your brushes will be slightly damaged.

This is cute. I haven't put the wheels on this. I put it on the top of my bathroom vanity to use as my cosmetics organizer and it works great for that purpose, so I can't speak to its portability or sturdiness when traveling.  I do get aggravated with the design of the side doors. They won't stay open out to the sides and swing inward immediately and the use of the little shelves made into them are limited because putting anything other than tiny items in them won't allow the doors to close. But

I love love love, it's perfect for when I'm on the go. I'm an esthetician and it carries all my products and any other extras I need to stay mobile. I always get a lot of compliments it's an amazing compact storage with a lot of room surprisingly also comes with locks and keys, no issues so far.

reviews.t: The wheels role great and come with a removable mirror that you can ...
reviews.x: The wheels role great and come with a removable mirror that you can use at the table.  If i had any complaints the top compartment was a little shorter than i expected. It litterally is tall enough for bottles of nail polish.  I wanted to use it to put foundation but my foundations were too tall.  I ended up putting them on the second shelf.
i absolutely love my case. no issues yet and ive had it 4 months, so nice to be able to go do makeovers and parties with!

reviews.t: Locks don't actually lock, but nice case otherwise

Love this case! Pros: being on casters makes transport very easy. Holds all my nail art supplies, polishes, uv light, and dremel making everything easily accessible. Also locks keeping my granddaughter out and obscuring everything will be there when I need it. Cons: very strong odor when you first get it. Leave it open for a few days, that will help. Also, the mirror doesn't stay put and falls out sometimes when I open the lid. Overall it was definitely worth the buy!
Absolutely love it, I can lock it to keep my 6 year old niece out, and can take the wheels off to put it on my desk. Holds alot.
I bought this for a birthday gift , it's really cute and good quality.

Well as a makeup artist and now an aesthetician, i would say I love this case. Ive had cases where i’m just annoyed after a few months because parts would be falling off. I am inlove with my kit and I am ordering another one for my skincare products.  It is spacious, the trays are sturdy and the outside is also sturdy, not to mention the colour and is pretty and the wheels are also sturdy, its a good buy. Enjoy.

reviews.t: not a bad case but not a great case
reviews.x: Case is compact and the wheels are great.  The shelves are strong and it holds a lot.  But the nail polish inserts are laughable.  They are way to small even for a opi sampler.  I guess its ok but I should have bought something bigger pay attention to the dimensions when you get this.

reviews.t: Beautiful case . Wish it was sturdier
reviews.x: I love the case I just wish it was sturdier I feel like it’s poorly structured and just made out of cardboard also its smaller than I imagined but honestly it fit everything perfect with extra room. Overall it’s avgood buy to keep organize and save space

My daughter has a lot of makeup and also is a make up artist.  The case is very functional because it opens like a cabinet.  Everything is visible and accessible.  Case kid easy to move with the roller wheels.
I like the case overall. The one thing I don't like is there is a small drawer that appears to pull out, but it really doesn't so it makes it difficult to get into the bottom compartment.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the case and find it spacious, holding all their makeup, nail supplies, and tools with room to spare.
Several reviewers report that the locks are fake or don't actually lock, despite keys being included.
Some reviewers find the case less sturdy or poorly structured than expected, and note it is smaller than imagined.
Reviewers praise the wheels and portability, saying the casters make transport easy and the wheels can be removed for desk use.
A few reviewers complain about design issues like side doors that won't stay open, shallow side storage, and brush holders that only fit short brushes.
